anomalies.observed: On the root sheet the MCU reset pin U2.7 and its pull-up R10 sit on the net labelled 'NRST', but the Tag-Connect header pin J1.3 is attached to a different net label, 'RESET'. Because the two carry different global/hierarchical label names, no wire connects them, so J1.3 is left as a single-pin (floating) net.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the reset line must be shared: 'R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC ... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.' J1.3 should therefore be on the same net as U2.7/R10 (i.e. labelled NRST).

evidence.quote: Root sheet, 'Programming (SWD)' block: J1 pin 3 carries the red net label 'RESET'; MCU block: U2 pin 7 (NRST) and R10 carry the red net label 'NRST'.
Reset line: R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC ... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.

anomalies.impact: The SWD/Tag-Connect programmer cannot assert the MCU's external reset pin; the J1 reset pad is unconnected to the MCU reset net. Board boot/reset behaviour is unchanged, but the documented programming interface loses its hardware-reset capability.
